sentences.en: My nephew was excused on the grounds of his youth.
sentences.zh: 由于年纪小，我侄子被免除了责任。

sentences.en: I tripped over a stone and fell to the ground.
sentences.zh: 我踩到了一块石头然后摔倒在地。

sentences.en: I stood my ground and got the contract I wanted.
sentences.zh: 我坚守立场，最终得到了那份合同。

senses.zh: 打基础；使搁浅；使接触地面
